vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: 03-storyboard-prompter
Version: 1.0.1

The skill is a straightforward utility for converting script scenes into AI image generation prompts. The implementation in skill.js performs simple string interpolation on input data without any network requests, file system access, or suspicious logic, aligning perfectly with the documentation in SKILL.md.

llm.summary: The skill's code and instructions are consistent with its stated purpose: it locally converts a list of scene objects into positive/negative image prompts and requests no external credentials or installs.

dimensions.detail: Name/description promise (generate local positive/negative prompts from short scripts) matches the manifest, SKILL.md, and the included skill.js, which constructs prompt strings from scene data. No unrelated resources (cloud creds, binaries) are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md limits the input to a scenes list and the code only uses inputs.scenes. The implementation simply concatenates s.scene, s.character, and s.action into the prompt—there is no file I/O or network activity. Minor note: there is no input validation, so missing fields in a scene may yield 'undefined' substrings in prompts; this is a correctness/usability issue rather than a security incoherence.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec present and no external downloads; the skill is instruction-only with a small local skill.js file. No archive downloads or package installs are required.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill declares no environment variables, credentials, or config paths and its behavior does not reference any secrets—requested privileges are minimal and proportional to its purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not modify other skills or system settings. It does not request persistent presence or elevated privileges.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is small and self-contained and appears to do what it says. Before installing: (1) confirm the scenes you pass are structured with scene, character, and action fields to avoid 'undefined' in prompts; (2) avoid embedding sensitive information in scene text because the skill will include those strings verbatim in generated prompts; (3) note the package metadata has no homepage and owner is an ID-only account—if provenance matters, prefer skills with a known publisher or repository; (4) if you later send these prompts to third-party image-generation APIs, treat them as data that could leak context or PII.
